category_edits.rationale: Scale each normalized input embedding by 1.25 when its nonpadding item appeared earlier in the visible causal context. This adds a deterministic repeat indicator while preserving embedding parameters, GRU topology, readout, loss, optimizer and routing. The generated predictor already imports the updated model class from train.py, so inference uses the same feature construction.
